name: subagent-dispatcher
description: General-purpose workflow guidance for dispatching focused Codex subagents on parallelizable work.

interface.longDescription: Subagent Dispatcher helps Codex decide when to split coding and non-coding work into focused subagents, assign clear scopes, and synthesize the results safely.
defaultPrompt: Use subagent-dispatcher for this multi-part task.
